title: Figure 1: Illustration of a squeezed state of light (energy density vs position)
description: Plot of ENERGY DENSITY versus POSITION titled "SQUEEZED STATE," showing an oscillating curve with large magenta positive lobes above zero and smaller blue negative lobes below zero. Caption reads "Figure 1. Illustration of a Squeezed State of Light. (courtesy of Lisa Burnett)." Text below introduces negative energy in the Casimir effect.
